name: Do I need a permit to build a detached ADU?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit to build a detached ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, permits are always required to build a detached ADU. This includes permits for construction, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical work. Local city planning and building departments will review your plans to ensure compliance with zoning ordinances, building codes, and safety regulations. Building without proper permits can lead to significant fines, required demolition, and difficulties when selling your property.
